statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail has eased below WATCH after the September Empire State release produced no verified one-way NQ response; rates and oil still keep the broader environment highly stressed.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below the block threshold because current evidence shows pressure without persistent mean-reversion failure; the U.S. cash open remains the next narrow conditional risk window.
headline: Tail eases below WATCH after orderly post-Empire pre-open response; Stress remains extreme
body: The New York Fed reported a September Empire State headline index of 7.6, below the 15 consensus cited by the Wall Street Journal, while pricing pressures intensified. Reuters at 12:32 UTC had Nasdaq-100 e-minis down 0.13%, the U.S. 10-year yield at 5.0122% and Brent at $106.31. Fresh Finviz context at 12:15 UTC showed delayed NQ -0.13%, VIX futures -0.01%, positive tracked semiconductors and mixed megacaps. This combination supports extreme Stress but does not verify persistent one-way NQ structure before the cash open.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock hours, Tail declined from elevated event/whipsaw conditions on Monday into low overnight, then returned to WATCH as yields, oil and technology sensitivity strengthened. The latest finalized 12:00 UTC assessment was 20% Tail with 97% Stress.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 19% low because the Empire State release did not produce a verified one-way NQ response and fresh supplementary context shows conflicting technology breadth. Conditional Tail returns to WATCH around the cash-open sequence if directional persistence, shallow pullbacks or failed retracements emerge, then eases unless that structure persists.

forecast.analysis: Empire State printed 7.6 versus 15 expected, while Reuters at 12:32 UTC had Nasdaq-100 e-minis down only 0.13%, the 10-year yield at 5.0122% and Brent at $106.31. The immediate response is pressured but not a verified one-way NQ path; the 13:30 UTC cash open remains a conditional checkpoint.
drivers: Empire State index 7.6, below the 15 consensus cited by WSJ
13:30 UTC cash open is still unobserved

forecast.analysis: After the cash close, reduced liquidity can widen moves, but a lower-liquidity move alone is not Tail evidence. Persistent extension without meaningful retracement would be required for escalation.

forecast.analysis: In the early overnight session, Tail remains low unless a new geopolitical or rates shock produces sustained directional follow-through. Existing oil and yield pressure is treated as Stress unless price structure confirms persistence.
drivers: New geopolitical or rates shocks are conditional overnight drivers
Existing oil and yield pressure mainly supports Stress

forecast.analysis: Asia-open conditions remain low-Tail by default. A fresh gap plus aligned semiconductors, megacaps and rates would be a stronger warning; conflicting breadth would keep the regime mixed rather than directional.
During Asian trade, the key conditional test is whether any overnight move repeatedly extends after failed pullbacks. Without that structure, volatility remains mainly a Stress consideration.

Later Asian hours retain a low Tail baseline unless NQ holds near overnight extremes while yields and oil move in the same adverse direction. Mean-reverting rotation would keep the path non-pathological.
At the Asia-to-Europe transition, gaps or liquidity shifts can raise noise without proving persistence. Tail stays low unless the move survives meaningful retracement attempts.
Early Europe can reprice rates and energy before U.S. participation. Tail remains low unless that repricing creates a sustained NQ trend with shallow pullbacks and aligned tech breadth.
By mid-Europe, Tail edges higher only if cross-asset pressure begins aligning ahead of the U.S. session. Stable yields or improving semiconductors would offset oil-driven stress.

forecast.analysis: Late European trade becomes more relevant as U.S. liquidity approaches. A coherent move across NQ, yields, oil and tech breadth would raise concern; mixed signals would keep Tail below WATCH.

forecastDetail.comment: Fresh official data and Reuters pricing show a pressured but non-pathological pre-open state: Empire State was 7.6, Nasdaq-100 e-minis were down 0.13%, and the cash open had not yet occurred.

The first full cash-session hour is the main conditional danger window; persistent opening extension with shallow pullbacks would keep Tail in WATCH, while meaningful retracement would argue against escalation.
After the opening sequence, Tail remains WATCH only if price repeatedly extends after failed retracements; two-way trade or semiconductor resilience would reduce concern.
Mid-morning risk depends on whether the opening move still holds near session extremes; yield stabilization or deeper pullbacks would favor de-escalation.
Late-morning Tail stays near the lower WATCH boundary only if rates and oil continue to reinforce persistent NQ direction; rotation through meaningful pullbacks would argue against escalation.
At midday, extreme Stress can persist without high Tail; stable volatility, mixed leadership and accessible retracements would keep the path non-pathological.
